props.caption: Technical Specifications — CSI MasterFormat Structure and Specification Types
props.description: Hierarchical diagram of CSI MasterFormat 50-division structure relevant to Philippine practice. Three specification types compared: Performance Specs (what building must achieve), Prescriptive Specs (exact materials/products), Proprietary Specs (brand-specific). Side panel shows architect's coordination with QS/cost estimator and specification integration with construction documents.
